r: Duelists, Welcome to YCS Rio de Janeiro, Brazil!
We’ve got a total of 368 Duelists ready to Duel their hardest to make it to the top.
We have representatives from many countries, including Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Mexico, Panama and of course, Brazil.
Good luck to all of our participating Duelists!
